features: PERP live OHLC now comes directly from TradingView Crypto Scanner PIONEX symbols every 10 seconds.
Uses https://scanner.tradingview.com/crypto/scan with selected PIONEX:...USDT.P tickers, avoiding the unstable Pionex browser/Worker realtime path.
Fetches current close/open/high/low, so the in-progress daily candle is rebuilt before recalculating S-State, midline slope, Average-K and CCI-SMA.
The TradingView request is sent as text/plain JSON so GitHub Pages can use the scanner CORS response without a Content-Type preflight.
Only changed cells are patched; the page never reloads or flashes.
Pionex/R2 remains responsible for tradable-universe validation, watchlist sync and historical daily-kline warm-up.
TradingView PIONEX scanner currently exposes PIONEX perpetual .P rows; SPOT retains the existing Pionex ticker fallback.
